name: Company Market Scan
description: A cited snapshot of public company and market information.
serviceType: Public company and market research summary
audience: Small teams deciding whether to evaluate a market or vendor.

offers.offerStatus: staged; legal review open; operator approval pending
offers.description: Test checkout only. No live payment is collected.

limits: One market or vendor category per order; sector input is 1 to 500 characters.
Public business sources only; no personal contact data or private records.
Descriptive research only; not investment, legal, accounting, or purchasing advice.

trust.verification: Every material factual claim includes a resolving public citation; source dates and unchecked areas are reported.
trust.authorization: Test authorization is captured only after delivery verification; failed citation validation releases the authorization.
trust.refund: A captured order is refundable if the delivered report materially misses its stated scope.
trust.privacy: No account or contact details are required. Do not submit passwords, payment data, personal contact data, or confidential information. The local test checkout uses a deterministic fixture and stores no real payment credentials.
